name: LabOosInvestigationTracker
tagline: GMP OOS / OOT laboratory investigations – Phase Ia, Ib, II and QA approval in one Power Platform app.
description: A complete QC laboratory module for out-of-specification, out-of-trend and atypical results: Phase Ia obvious-error checklist, Phase Ib hypothesis testing with protocol-limited second-analyst retests and resample justification, Phase II manufacturing investigation with CAPA and batch disposition, four-eyes QA approval, deadlines and extensions, and trending of laboratory invalidation rates and repeat failures. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: 8 KPIs incl. lab invalidation rate and batches on hold
Drag-and-drop phase board with phase rules
Second-analyst and retest-limit rules (no testing into compliance)
Phase II with deviation, CAPA, impact and disposition
Four-eyes QA approval with e-signature meaning
Phase I and closure deadlines per priority, extensions
Repeat signals per test + instrument and product + test
